transportMethod.measured: Actual Worker postMessage calls and real response-event counts plus client facade admission/delivery counts are recorded separately; UTF-8 JSON logical envelope bytes include metadata. Fault injections and duplicate physical posts remain visible rather than being mistaken for one adapter call.
transportMethod.knownImplementationCopies: Caller admission captures plain owned data, JSON measurement encodes a string, browser postMessage structured-clones, host capture validates owned data, and reply delivery crosses structured clone. Counts and encoded bytes do not determine concurrent retained buffers.
transportMethod.peakCopies: Not measured. Browser internal structured-clone buffers, lifetime overlap and allocation overhead are not observable through this facade.
transportMethod.workerHeap: Not measured. Encoded transport bytes and gzip/bundle bytes are not retained or peak heap.
